name: Purple United Sales Ltd
tagline: Rs ~395 Cr kidswear retailer (apparel, footwear, accessories) scaling store count from 43 (Mar-25) to ~111 (Apr-26) toward 200+ -- ROCE ~23%, ROE ~22%, ~46% profit CAGR over 5 yrs, improving working capital -- an execution-dependent retail rollout at a full-ish multiple
business_overview: Purple United Sales (NSE: PURPLEUTED) is a kids' apparel, footwear and fashion-accessories retailer selling through own retail, e-commerce and wholesale channels across India, in the middle of an aggressive store-expansion phase.
fundamentals_narrative: The return ratios (ROCE / ROE ~22-25%) and the 5-year profit CAGR (~46%) are good, and working capital has clearly improved (debtor days 194 -> 128, WC days 168 -> 116). The growth engine is store-count expansion -- more than doubling in a year with a stated 200+ target -- which is inherently execution- and capital-intensive, and same-store economics through a rapid rollout are unproven at this scale. Kidswear apparel retail is a large but competitive category (FirstCry, Hopscotch, D2C brands, unorganised trade); the moat is an as-yet-unbuilt retail brand.

Kidswear retail is competitive (FirstCry, Hopscotch, D2C, unorganised); no established brand moat yet
Full-ish multiple (~Rs 395 Cr mcap) leaves limited margin for rollout slippage

verdict_headline: Decent-quality kidswear retailer mid-rollout, but execution-dependent growth at a full-ish multiple -- 'neither', conviction Low-Medium

four_box score 2.0 -> 'neither'. tailwind weak (kidswear branded-retail shift is real but slow and contested), tam weak (large category, but a ~Rs 395 Cr retailer's near-term runway is 3-5x, not 10x), moat weak (retail brand being built; 111 stores, no pricing power yet), valuation weak (full-ish multiple, no cushion for slippage). No written exception -- growth is real but rollout-dependent, not un-ignorable.

Conviction Low-Medium: above Low for the return ratios, profit CAGR and improving cash cycle; capped by rollout-execution risk, competition, valuation and the untrusted source. Re-check after two-plus quarters show the expanded store base holding ROCE and same-store growth.
